items.exampleEn: The scar from the incision faded after a few months.
items.exampleZh: 切口留下的疤痕過了幾個月就淡了。

items.exampleEn: Empty shops are symptomatic of the problems facing the town center.
items.exampleZh: 空蕩的店面反映出市中心面臨的問題。

items.exampleEn: After days of rain, the bathroom walls felt clammy.
items.exampleZh: 下了好幾天雨後，浴室的牆摸起來又濕又冷。

items.exampleEn: Rugby is a sport of great physicality and speed.
items.exampleZh: 橄欖球是一項非常講究身體對抗和速度的運動。

items.exampleEn: She keeps a small tin of salve in her bag.
items.exampleZh: 她包包裡放著一小罐藥膏。

items.exampleEn: A baby's first incisors usually appear at about six months.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶的第一批門牙通常在六個月大左右長出來。

items.exampleEn: Researchers measured how students reacted to different stimuli.
items.exampleZh: 研究人員測量學生對不同刺激的反應。

items.sentenceEn: My hands were cold and clammy before the interview.
items.sentenceZh: 面試前，我的手又冷又濕。

items.audioEn: Rabbits use their sharp incisors to cut through plants.
items.audioZh: 兔子用鋒利的門牙咬斷植物。
options: To dig holes in the soil

items.sentenceEn: The dancer's physicality made the story easy to follow.
items.sentenceZh: 那位舞者的肢體表現讓故事很容易看懂。

items.sentenceEn: Babies respond to stimuli such as light and sound.
items.sentenceZh: 嬰兒會對光線和聲音等刺激產生反應。

items.stemEn: The chef made a small ____ in the skin of each tomato.
items.stemZh: 主廚在每顆番茄的皮上劃了一道小切口。

items.stemEn: Long lines at the hospital are ____ of a bigger problem: there are too few doctors.
items.stemZh: 醫院大排長龍反映出更大的問題：醫生太少了。

items.passageEn: Before her first big role, the young actress worked with a movement coach to improve her physicality on stage. The coach taught her to react to stimuli, such as a sudden noise or a change in light, without thinking. On opening night, her hands were clammy with nerves, but once the play began, she forgot her fear, and the audience was exuberant. Afterwards, the director told her that her stage fright was not symptomatic of a lack of talent; even famous actors feel it. A kind review in the newspaper was a welcome salve after weeks of hard work.
items.passageZh: 接下第一個重要角色之前，那位年輕女演員和一位動作教練合作，加強她在舞台上的肢體表現。教練教她不假思索地對刺激做出反應，例如突然的聲響或光線的變化。首演當晚，她緊張得手心又冷又濕，但演出一開始，她就忘了害怕，觀眾也熱情洋溢。演出後，導演告訴她，怯場並不表示她缺乏天分，就連知名演員也會怯場。報上一篇溫暖的評論，對她辛苦了好幾個星期的努力是很大的安慰。

options: 立刻對聲光變化做出反應

questions.questionZh: 導演說她的怯場代表什麼？

referenceEn: My son lost one of his incisors.
My son has lost a front incisor.
rubricZh: incisor 表示「門牙」（例如 one of his incisors、a front incisor 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 lost、has lost 等）

items.promptZh: 動物園的工作人員每天給動物新的玩具，提供不同的刺激。
referenceEn: The zoo staff give the animals new toys every day to provide different stimuli.
Every day, zoo workers give the animals new toys as fresh stimuli.
rubricZh: 「刺激」用複數名詞 stimuli（例如 different stimuli、fresh stimuli 等）
「工作人員」可寫，例如 staff、workers 等；主詞與動詞單複數配合皆可（例如 staff give、staff gives 等）
說的是習慣，時態配合內容

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：「一份令人欣慰的安慰」語意重複、不通順；a welcome salve 可譯「一劑令人欣慰的慰藉」或「一份及時的安慰」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改譯「報上一篇溫暖的評論，對她辛苦了好幾個星期的努力是很大的安慰」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：「This salve can soothe dry and cracked lips.」是產品功效敘述，接近保健／用藥建議（§11-11、§11-30）；可改中性句，如 She keeps a small tin of salve in her bag.
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示改成不帶療效的 She keeps a small tin of salve in her bag.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：同詞性 mcq 的 fatigue、physicality 不可數，放不進 a small ____，可數性洩題
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依建議換成同單元可數名詞 midwife、fatality，代入後語意都不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A 疑似 11：physicality 第一義「身體素質」與例句「身體對抗」對不上
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示第一義改「身體對抗」，與例句一致

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：incisor 表示「門牙」（例如 one of his incisors、a front incisor 等）／時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 lost、has lost 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：stimuli 是 stimulus 的複數，表示「刺激」，動詞要配合複數（例如 stimuli that make…、these stimuli are 等）／句子要說到你自己

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（stimuli）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u14-l02-q16；目標字沿用 stimuli
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「動物園的工作人員每天給動物新的玩具，提供不同的刺激。」、hintWords ["stimuli"]、referenceEn ["The zoo staff give the animals new toys every day to provide different stimuli.","Every day, zoo workers give the animals new toys as fresh stimuli."]、rubricZh ["「刺激」用複數名詞 stimuli（例如 different stimuli、fresh stimuli 等）","「工作人員」可寫，例如 staff、workers 等；主詞與動詞單複數配合皆可（例如 staff give、staff gives 等）","說的是習慣，時態配合內容"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 stimuli 造一個句子，說說哪些刺激會讓你分心或提神。」、referenceEn ["Loud music and bright lights are stimuli that make it hard for me to study.","I work best when there are few stimuli around me, like in a quiet library."]）
